title: Emergency patch emitted as a verified plan
code_snippet:
# Emitted under S9.7 for the user to run:
git status --porcelain go.mod go.sum   # must be empty
go mod why -m golang.org/x/net
go get golang.org/x/net@v0.17.0
go mod tidy
git diff go.mod go.sum
go mod verify && go build ./... && go test ./...
govulncheck ./... ; echo rc=$?    # rc=0 confirms resolution
expected_feedback: No violations. Precondition checked before anything moves, the module that actually pulls the dependency in is identified first, the version is named rather than swept with -u, the go.mod diff is inspected because minimal version selection re-solves the graph, and resolution is confirmed by a re-scan rather than by a successful build.
